query:
SELECT month AS period, 'All' AS segment, 100.0 * SUM(unit_price * unit_discount * qty) / NULLIF(SUM(unit_price * qty), 0) AS value
FROM sales_lines
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
